items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Could that be Heal Hefti? [INTERVIEWEE] No, not Neal Hefti.

ctx.x: Yeah, he used to conduct the band a lot. And there was another guy that used to, he was a white guy, he used to write arrangements and things, he used to conduct…
No, not Neal Hefti. This guy is dead now, he used to write, he was a big guy— played piano. Oh, what‘s his name? Oh man…
